DIRECTION IS THE PRIMARY REQUIREMENT: TRUE WEST SIDE PROFILE. Nose points horizontally LEFT, tail RIGHT. Only ONE eye visible. The far eye and far side of snout must be completely hidden. Do not use a front-left or three-quarter-facing pose.
Production transparent game animation atlas for Safety Last. Reference image supplies ONLY the animal identity and exact hand-painted chibi RPG style. Omit game scene, HUD, terrain, person and shadows.
Draw EXACTLY 24 separate complete full-body poses arranged FOUR columns by SIX rows. Same identity/body size across all cells; same elevated overhead game camera and upper-left lighting. Keep each entire silhouette with ample empty padding inside its invisible cell. Body root remains centred: attacks change posture without moving across the cell. Frame order left-to-right top-to-bottom:
Row1: 4 WALK poses, alternating opposing foreleg/hindleg contacts and passing.
Row2: 4 RUN poses, compression, hind push, airborne extension, landing.
Row3: idle standing; same idle with eyes CLOSED; alert warning; first anticipation.
Row4: final obvious wind-up; attack launch; actual attack contact; follow-through.
Row5: attack recovery; standing ready again; hit flinch eyes squeezed; hit recovery.
Row6: staggering; falling to side; downed still on side; same downed eyes shut.
All 24 must be complete and separate. Genuine transparent alpha pixels everywhere outside animals. NO solid or brown background, NO gradients behind sprites, NO checkerboard painted, NO ground, shadows, text, grid lines, blood or wounds. Match outlines, broad painted colour shapes and readable small-game details. Not photorealistic, not 3D render, not pixel art.
IDENTITY: WILD BOAR from reference. Preserve exact approved character and painted shading.
